CREATE TABLE dingtalk_synced_nodes (
    id INTEGER NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
    dingtalk_node_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
    name VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
    doc_url VARCHAR(1024) NOT NULL, 
    parent_node_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', 
    node_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
    workspace_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', 
    content_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', 
    content_updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
    is_active BOOL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, 
    last_synced_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
    updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
    PRIMARY KEY (id)
)ENGINE=InnoDB CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='DingTalk synced document nodes'
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_dingtalk_nodes_user_node ON dingtalk_synced_nodes (user_id, dingtalk_node_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_dingtalk_nodes_user_parent ON dingtalk_synced_nodes (user_id, parent_node_id)
